evals.name: gap-analysis-explicit-plan
evals.prompt: Compare the current codebase to docs/plans/implementation-plan.md and tell me what's done, what's partial, what's missing, and what's divergent. Write a gap analysis artifact I can hand to the next reviewer.
evals.expected_output: Structured artifact at .claude/artifacts/eng-reviews/gap-analysis-*.md matching the schema: Summary line with counts, Gap Diagram, Components section with Status/Planned/Actual/Confidence per item, Dependency Order, Unexpected Code list, and a Next-stage hand-off hint line.

evals.name: status-check-framing
evals.prompt: Am I done with docs/plans/implementation-plan.md? What's left?
evals.expected_output: Same structured artifact, scoped by the same design doc. Output ends with a short completion report pointing the user to /review-code-quality as the next step. Classification uses COMPLETE/PARTIAL/MISSING/DIVERGENT/UNEXPECTED labels with confidence scores.
